parameters.query:
INSERT INTO bot_users (chat_id, state, name, company, phone, tg_name, username,
lottery, last_msg_id, registered_at)
VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
ON DUPLICATE KEY
UPDATE
  state = VALUES(state),
  name = VALUES(name),
  company = VALUES(company),
  phone =
VALUES(phone),
  tg_name = VALUES(tg_name),
  username = VALUES(username),
  lottery =
VALUES(lottery),
  last_msg_id = VALUES(last_msg_id),
  registered_at =
COALESCE(VALUES(registered_at), registered_at);
